name: Pleasing God Rather Than People
overview: Scripture calls believers to prioritize pleasing God over seeking the approval or fear of men, recognizing that trust in human opinion leads to spiritual danger and separation from the Lord. Proverbs teaches that when a person's ways please God, even enemies are made peaceful toward them, highlighting the power of divine favor. The fear of man is described as a snare, whereas trusting in the Lord brings safety and exaltation. Jesus emphasizes fearing God, who has authority over both soul and body, rather than fearing those who can only harm the body. Ultimately, true faith seeks the honor that comes from God alone, not from human praise.
